## Scope and limitations

- Reynolds numbers, mesh resolutions, and units are reported only when explicit source metadata is detected; otherwise they remain unknown.
- Expected configurations (Re 560 and 11240; coarse, medium, and fine meshes) have not been verified against a dataset.
- Archive entries are inventoried without extraction.
- The built-in inspector reads bounded metadata; it does not decode large CFD field arrays.
- Preprocessing currently supports only CSV point tables with explicit x, y, and z columns.
- No train/test split is created. Grouped splitting requires verified case-family metadata and spatial block configuration.

## Warnings

- Re11240/coarse/layerInfo/region0/layerInfo.vtk: Legacy VTK inspection reads only the bounded file header.
- Re11240/coarse/system/controlDict: OpenFOAM mesh point/cell counts are not computed; binary mesh topology is retained as source data.
- Re11240/fine/layerInfo/region0/layerInfo.vtk: Legacy VTK inspection reads only the bounded file header.
- Re11240/fine/system/controlDict: OpenFOAM mesh point/cell counts are not computed; binary mesh topology is retained as source data.
- Re11240/medium/layerInfo/region0/layerInfo.vtk: Legacy VTK inspection reads only the bounded file header.
- Re11240/medium/system/controlDict: OpenFOAM mesh point/cell counts are not computed; binary mesh topology is retained as source data.
- Re560/coarse/layerInfo/region0/layerInfo.vtk: Legacy VTK inspection reads only the bounded file header.
- Re560/coarse/system/controlDict: OpenFOAM mesh point/cell counts are not computed; binary mesh topology is retained as source data.
- Re560/fine/layerInfo/region0/layerInfo.vtk: Legacy VTK inspection reads only the bounded file header.
- Re560/fine/system/controlDict: OpenFOAM mesh point/cell counts are not computed; binary mesh topology is retained as source data.
- Re560/medium/layerInfo/region0/layerInfo.vtk: Legacy VTK inspection reads only the bounded file header.
- Re560/medium/system/controlDict: OpenFOAM mesh point/cell counts are not computed; binary mesh topology is retained as source data.
